subject: Quick recap + leadership intro to unblock pilot
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@highlineretail.com>, Tomas Rivera <tomas.rivera@highlineretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Quick recap + leadership intro to unblock pilot
Attachments: pilot-scope-slide-deck.pdf (pdf), redwood-datasheet-v3.pdf (pdf)

Hi Lena, Tomas,

Thanks again for the productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps to keep momentum: 

Summary of needs we heard
- Target latency under 120ms p50 for user-facing flows across 20 concurrent sessions
- Data residency requirement: US-only for PII processing; logs can be retained in our EU region for analytics
- Pilot scope: 2 models (chat + embeddings) for a 6-week technical pilot with production-like traffic (approx 5000 req/day)
- Cost goal: target 30% reduction vs your current managed endpoint spend via batching and KV caching

Proposed next step
We recommend a 45-minute leadership handshake that pairs your technical leadership with our product/engineering leadership to: 
1) align on pilot success criteria and security boundary assumptions
2) confirm the technical deep-dive agenda for the follow-on session

Would Marissa Cole (VP Product) and Ben Carter (Solutions Eng) be useful on our side for this session? If so, please share two 45-minute slots next week that work for your CTO and VP of infra so we can coordinate calendars. Suggested windows (Pacific time): 
- Tue 2026-11-17 09:30-10:15 or 14:00-14:45
- Wed 2026-11-18 11:00-11:45

I attached a short pilot scope deck and our latest datasheet to help shape the agenda.

Thanks,
Sergio
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com

From: Tomas Rivera <tomas.rivera@highlineretail.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@highlineretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T16:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + leadership intro to unblock pilot

Thanks Sergio — good summary. Lena and I reviewed internally. Our CTO, Maya Chen, is available next week on the following 45-minute windows (PT): 
- Tue 2026-11-17 14:00-14:45 (works)
- Wed 2026-11-18 11:00-11:45 (might work but we have a standing all-hands; tentative)

We'll plan to include our Head of Infrastructure, Jordan Park. Can you confirm who from Redwood will be on the call and the objective you intend to cover in the 45 minutes? Also, please make sure the pilot scope deck includes the proposed traffic profile and an initial data handling diagram.

Best,
Tomas
Director, Platform Engineering
Highline Retail

Appreciate the quick reply Tomas — looping in Marissa and Ben to align schedules and objectives. 

Marissa, Ben — short ask: can you join a 45-minute leadership handshake with Highline? They suggested Tue 11/17 14:00 PT as the preferred slot. The objectives for the 45-minute meeting would be:
- Confirm pilot success criteria and the acceptance tests (latency/cost/quality)
- Align on high-level security boundary and data residency commitments for the pilot
- Decide attendees and scope for the follow-on technical deep dive (SE-led)

Ben, could you prepare a 10-minute technical snapshot (traffic profile + KV cache approach + initial infra diagram) so we can keep the rest of the time for leadership alignment? I attached the pilot deck and datasheet for context.

If Tue 11/17 14:00 PT works for everyone I'll send the calendar invite and include a proposed 3-point agenda. Otherwise suggest an alternate slot.

Thanks — Sergio
